title: Research defense and next questions
outcome: Explain research defense and next questions using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Defend the next research question. A research defence identifies a observed weakness and a testable follow-up.
given: A frozen model is correct on 8/10 clear images and 4/10 shaded images. Source objects are grouped within each condition.

steps.label: Limit the interpretation
steps.detail: Shade sensitivity is plausible, but camera or object differences may also matter.

steps.label: Design follow-up
steps.detail: Photograph the same held-out objects under both light conditions using one camera and fixed scoring.

explanation: A defence should explain results, uncertainty and what would discriminate between explanations next. A controlled paired follow-up is more informative than simply collecting extra easy images.

counterfactual.change: Change cameras as well as lighting in the follow-up.
counterfactual.prediction: The design again entangles two conditions.
counterfactual.reason: A camera difference provides another explanation for any performance gap.

student_task: Compute the clear and shaded rates and identify alternative explanations. How does the same-object, one-camera follow-up help, and why does changing cameras again reintroduce confounding?
teacher_answer: Clear is 80%; shaded is 40%. Shade sensitivity is plausible, but camera or object differences may also matter. Photograph the same held-out objects under both light conditions using one camera and fixed scoring. Changed case: The design again entangles two conditions. A camera difference provides another explanation for any performance gap.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: Even a paired follow-up needs adequate independent objects and justified analysis; no causal conclusion is claimed yet.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
